subject: Cross-region co-sell demo + AWS marketplace preflight - propose dates
messages:
From: Anita Shah <anita@cloudfabric.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed: cross-region co-sell demo + AWS marketplace preflight

Hi Priya —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. CloudFabric is excited to do a joint demo that highlights the new multi-region routing we've built on top of Redwood’s serving runtime. Important context: our AWS listing team wants to see a short demonstration (20–25 mins) that verifies how traffic routing and fallback behave across US/EU regions, plus an ops-runbook we can reference for the marketplace listing.

Proposed goals for the session:
- 20m demo (2 use cases: low-latency path + fallback)
- 10m Q&A and marketplace checklist review
- Confirm assignees for AWS preflight items (IAM snapshot, pricing table, support contact)

We're aiming for the week of Jun 26–30. Tentative times that work for our team (PST):
- Tue Jun 27 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed Jun 28 15:00–16:00 PT (preferable for our APAC folks)

I've attached a short agenda and a one-pager that the AWS listing team asked to see: CF-demo-agenda-v1.pdf (attachment).

Can you confirm availability? Also, who on your side should be the marketplace owner so we can pre-fill the AWS seller console fields?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this into the marketplace.

— Anita Shah
Head of Alliances, CloudFabric
Anita Shah | CloudFabric Inc.

Hi Anita —

Appreciate the agenda — this looks tight and actionable. Priors from our side: we should bring a short runbook (how routing/fallback is configured in Dedicated vs Hosted) and the person who will own the AWS seller fields. Karthik will drive the co-sell narrative and Soojin will handle ops/runbook details.

Availability from Redwood:
- Tue Jun 27 10:00–11:00 PT — Karthik & I can make this
- Wed Jun 28 15:00–16:00 PT — Soojin has a conflict, so Tue is better for ops continuity

Can you lock Tue Jun 27 10:00 PT? If that works we'll send a calendar invite and attach our demo runbook (redwood-demo-runbook.xlsx).

Quick asks before the call:
1) Can you share the AWS seller account email that will be used for the listing?
2) Any non-disclosure constraints for the live demo (screens/sharing)?

I'll attach the runbook and a short preflight checklist we run for Marketplace listings.

Best,

Priya Natarajan
Partner Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

- We'll run the demo against our staging model variants (v1.9 quantized) with a short canary so we can switch to hosted fallback if there are perf spikes. Soojin, I'll need the step-by-step notes for the failover sequence (can you add them to the runbook before Monday?).
- Anita, for the AWS listing please provide the seller email and the support contact (name + email). AWS also wants a 1-line summary we can publish — I'll draft a blurb, but if you have marketing-approved copy please share.
- I'll create a quick HubSpot activity and link it here for the record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/contact/67890

Soojin — pinging you to update the runbook and confirm the rehearsal time. I recommend a 20-minute dry run Mon Jun 26 09:30 PT so we can test region failover live (short and focused).
